reviewMethod: Actual final paired source/model sheets personally opened and all six rows compared after the final native/export/render changes; manually written per-ID observations are bound to exact current files.
sourceLimitations: The original PNGs provide six projected views, without calibrated metres, hidden topology, lighting or texture/stance measurements. Source-specific dimensions and depths remain authored geometric estimates; no one-percent or absolute-scale fidelity certification is made.
productionMotionScope: Enemy production gait/flight/abilities, freeze/petrify/reduced-motion variants and surface/coverage probes are validated separately by independent runtime audits; attackStyle is an equipment descriptor, not a production attack-animation certification.
